title: Weights admittance, conversion, and benchmark orchestrator
creator: Anika Rao
description: Create an end-to-end orchestrator that admits community weights, performs deterministic conversion and provenance signing, runs a targeted benchmark and smoke validation suite, and publishes a runtime-ready performance profile and pin recommendation. The goal is to reduce manual handoffs, shorten time-to-ready for new open-source LLMs, and provide reproducible telemetry for QA and canary rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: New weights can be uploaded and accepted through the admittance API with signed manifest produced
Conversion stage produces reproducible runtime artifacts and a quantization candidate bundle
Automated benchmark suite (latency, memory, throughput, sample-perf on typical prompts) completes and emits a profile artifact
Pin recommendation heuristic outputs a primary pin and 1-2 fallback variants with confidence scores
Profile and pin published to catalog and visible in Console with telemetry links
End-to-end flow completes within SLO: 90th percentile pipeline latency < 45 minutes for medium models (< 8B parameters)
updates: 2026-03-03: Kickoff meeting with Runtime, Ingest, and QE. Agreed on three-stage pipeline: admittance -> conversion -> benchmark. Decided to reuse galley fingerprint format for provenance.
2026-03-05: Prototype admittance API implemented (POST /admit). Supports signed-manifest upload and lightweight schema validation. Live demo with LLaMA-2 community weight succeeded.
2026-03-07: Conversion PoC using deterministic exporter completed. Trade-off: slower export (20% longer) but reproducible byte-level artifacts. Opted for reproducibility for auditability.

2026-03-09: Benchmark harness integrated with runtime CI. Initial runs show batching/kernels selection differs for converted artifacts; observed 12% latency regression on 4k context compared to hand-tuned baseline. QE investigating kernel selection flags.
2026-03-11: Design review feedback from Security: require KMS envelope for manifest signing and retention of original checksum. Added privacy note for private-source models.

2026-03-12: Pin heuristic early results: primary pin chosen based on median latency + correctness delta; produces fallback pins with quantization vs fp16 trade-offs. Need to surface fallback justification in Console.
2026-03-13: Integration test flake: canonical-pin creation fails when two conversion workers process same artifact. Implemented optimistic lock on canonical creation. PR submitted.
2026-03-14: Can run end-to-end in staging for a 3B model in ~28 minutes. Next: expand smoke prompts, add KV-cache warmup step, and notify Console team for UI surface.
implementation_notes: Admittance API should return a short-lived ingestion token for conversion workers
Use deterministic torchscript export with fixed RNG seed and layer ordering to ensure reproducible artifact hashes
Conversion workers must emit explicit capability matrix for runtime (ops supported, optimal kv-cache warmup length, memory footprint)
Benchmark harness will run three profiles: micro-latency (single request), throughput (steady stream at target qps), and qualitative (prompt-set correctness/consistency)
Telemetry sink should attach run_id and provenance_fingerprint to the profile artifact for traceability
Pin recommendation algorithm: score = alpha*median_latency_norm + beta*quality_delta + gamma*memory_penalty; expose alphas in logs for audit
Implement optimistic canonical pin creation with 5s backoff and verification that fingerprint maps to identical conversion artifact before publishing
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Non-deterministic conversions lead to spurious pin flips. Mitigation: enforce byte-reproducibility in canonical path and add CI gate that rejects conversions that change hash
Risk: Benchmarks leak sample prompts. Mitigation: scrub prompts and create synthetic prompt-set for public runs, store raw prompts only in access-controlled buckets
Risk: Long-running conversions block pipeline. Mitigation: add size-based fast-path that runs a lightweight smoke-conversion for initial profiling and schedules full conversion asynchronously
